answer: Make independent judgment the admission price. Each epoch an identity gets a sealed forecast task about a random peer's next move, commits its prediction before the outcome lands, and is scored on accuracy and on how far it diverges from everyone else. Clones sharing one mind emit near-identical forecasts, so correlation, not shared keys, is what clusters them and cuts their pay to a single share. A farmer must then buy separate reasoning, context and data per head and keep each accurate, while one real sparrow keeps its own thread and a rack of ivory copies collapses into one.
